# Dither

Deterministic Bayer 8×8 ordered dithering for images.
Studio: https://dither.matthieu.pm/
MCP endpoint: https://dither.matthieu.pm/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless, POST. No authentication required.

## Tools

- get_dither_presets: list classic, fine and soft settings.
- dither_image: return a dithered PNG as MCP image content plus metadata.
- get_dither_shader: return the equivalent WebGL 2 GLSL fragment shader.

## dither_image

Provide exactly one image source:
- image_url: public HTTPS URL, port 443, no credentials, up to 8 MB.
- image_base64: base64 bytes or a PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF data URL, up to 2.75 MB decoded.

Still PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF images only. Up to 24 megapixels decoded.
No local paths, private network URLs, animation, SVG or HTML.

Options:
- preset: classic (default), fine, soft.
- pixel_size: integer 1–16, output pixels; overrides preset.
- color_levels: integer 2–16 per RGB channel; overrides preset.
- strength: 0–1; zero preserves decoded source pixels after orientation/resize.
- grain: 0–0.2 deterministic color grain; overrides preset.
- max_width: integer 64–4096, default 2048. Fit inside this width and height; no upscaling.

Classic: pixel_size 4, color_levels 4, strength 1, grain 0.035.
Fine: pixel_size 2, color_levels 6, strength 1, grain 0.015.
Soft: pixel_size 3, color_levels 5, strength 0.7, grain 0.02.

The output preserves alpha, uses sRGB and corrects EXIF orientation.
The output image content contains base64 PNG bytes; save them to a .png file.
The structured result contains dimensions, byte size, algorithm and settings.
Images are processed in memory and not persisted; no hosted image URL is created.
PNG output is limited to 2.9 MB. Reduce max_width, color_levels or grain if output is too large.
Total JSON request body limit: 3.9 MB.
The public remote endpoint can fetch image URLs: only submit URLs you intend it to retrieve.

## Connection example

{"mcpServers":{"dither":{"url":"https://dither.matthieu.pm/mcp"}}}

Example tool arguments (substitute an accessible image URL):
{"image_url":"https://example.com/photo.jpg","preset":"classic","max_width":2048}

## HTTP API

POST https://dither.matthieu.pm/api/dither
Content-Type: application/json
Body: same arguments as dither_image.
Success: image/png bytes. Error: JSON with an error message.

## Browser studio

Browser images are processed locally in a worker, using the same dithering code as the MCP renderer.
Browser upload limit: 20 MB, 24 megapixels. Export longest edge: up to 1024, 2048 or 4096 pixels.
The browser does not upload your chosen image to this server.
Browser and server decoders/resizers can differ slightly; dithering settings and Bayer matrix are shared.
The reference screenshot's exact original shader is unconfirmed; this is a Bayer dithering implementation.

Built by Matthieu Duchatellier: https://matthieu.pm
